'''Rasha''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] fought at the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|battle]] for [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Third Galactic War|renewed conflict]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the Republic.<ref name="Onslaught" />
